user.title: Google Assistant WebRTC Cameras
user.description: Installing this integration makes Home Assistant offer WebRTC (with HLS fallback) when Google Assistant shows a camera on a Nest display. There is nothing to configure: removing the integration restores stock behaviour.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

trait_changed.title: Google Assistant WebRTC Cameras is inactive
trait_changed.description: Home Assistant {ha_version} changed the Google Assistant camera trait in a way this integration does not recognise ({detail}). Google Assistant keeps the stock HLS behaviour. Check for an update of the integration.

core_has_webrtc.title: Google Assistant WebRTC Cameras is no longer needed
core_has_webrtc.description: Home Assistant {ha_version} already offers WebRTC to Google Assistant itself. This integration stood down and can be removed.

no_https.title: WebRTC for Google Assistant needs an HTTPS URL
no_https.description: The URL Home Assistant hands to Google for camera streams ({scheme}://…) is not HTTPS, so Google's player cannot reach the WebRTC signalling endpoint. Google Assistant keeps the stock HLS behaviour. Set an HTTPS internal or external URL (Settings → System → Network) that your displays can reach, then this issue clears on its own.

confirm.title: Google device sync
confirm.description: Home Assistant could not ask Google to re-sync your devices ({reason}). Say "Hey Google, sync my devices" to any Google device, then submit this form. The issue also clears by itself once a sync arrives.

confirm.title: Retry WebRTC for {entity_id}
confirm.description: Google's player could not negotiate a WebRTC stream for {entity_id} ({reason}). Google displays receive the stock HLS stream for this camera. Google's displays need H.264 or VP8 video (480p–1080p); HEVC/H.265 cameras need an H.264 sub-stream. After changing the camera's stream, submit this form to try WebRTC again.
